Confirmed. Cremona section 2.7 supplies one oldform copy for each divisor of N/M. At N=22, the level-11 form contributes two copies, S2(Gamma0(22)) has dimension two and its new part vanishes; the Jacobian Tate module has dimension four. The displayed multiplicity-free formula gives dimension two. Use a correctly stated constituent result or a decomposition indexed by Galois orbits with divisor multiplicities and restriction of scalars on coefficient-field completions. Request the Jacobian old/new decomposition from ModularCurvesPartII R14.5, using the ModularForms Layer 4 decomposition, and then R19.6 for each A_f Tate comparison. R19.6 currently supplies only the individual A_f comparison. Removing the wrong formula does not by itself verify the rest of the converse proof; semisimplicity alone is not irreducibility.

Confirmed. The three tests contain no non-membership assertion and their membership assertions are already forced by small primes or bad reduction. Exact curve arithmetic verifies the proposed examples. For 11a1, Delta=-11^5 and v11(j)=-5; at the good prime 3, a3=-1 makes the mod-7 Frobenius discriminant 3, a nonsquare, so there is no rational cyclic subgroup of order 7 and 7 is outside Sigma. For the displayed 26b1 equation, (1,0) has order seven, Delta=-2^7*13 and v2(j)=-7, giving 7 in Sigma. This latter test exercises both substantive clauses simultaneously, so it catches deleting both but does not separately test each. The report supplies an additional valuation-only example and records the limitation. Add named tests to the packet and suggested file; no full classification of all exceptional primes is needed for these assertions.

Confirmed, with a necessary correction to the proposed fix. A literal name comparison finds all twelve packet tests absent and the eight identified API names absent even from comments. The pinned Newform structure does exist and requires a nonzero natural level, integer weight and the inherited character data. Correct the header and use that actual carrier for stateable APIs; preserve every required hypothesis. In particular, a constructor newformOf E : Newform N 2 for arbitrary N is false, even if a comment says that N will eventually be the conductor. Retain a mathematically sufficient level condition and the initial M-divides-N/exact-conductor distinction. Name stateable tests exactly as in the packet, and record genuinely unstateable conductor/residual/Jacobian contracts precisely without pretending comments are elaborated signatures or using opaque Prop fields. No Lean compilation or complete library absence audit is claimed by this verification.
